note: All 99 template concepts of the design research, as data. Only the looks in templates.v1.json are built; the rest wait for week 2 (their own texture and type). Hebrew names of categories are null until a native speaker writes them.

subcategories.name: Boho / flea-market living room
subcategories.dna: Mismatched vintage furniture spilled onto the pavement, carpets and couches, every chair looks found; a home that happens to sell coffee.

variants.name: Flea Living Room
variants.surface: Worn oak tabletop with the edge of a faded red carpet showing
variants.light: Afternoon window light plus one warm bulb; soft shadows
variants.motion: The relief settles like a plate set down on a rug: a 2-degree wobble, then still
variants.sound: Lo-fi room tone, cups, a slow reggae record from the next room

variants.name: Sidewalk Sofa
variants.surface: Sun-bleached painted wood with the stripe of an umbrella shadow across it
variants.light: Hard noon sun, umbrella shade stripes, high contrast
variants.motion: The shade stripe pans slowly across the dish, as if the sun is moving
variants.sound: Street ambience: scooter, espresso steam, laid-back surf-rock

variants.name: Chalkboard House
variants.surface: Black chalkboard slate with faint chalk scribbles and a wiped corner
variants.light: A single pendant bulb pool on a dark room
variants.motion: The dish name is chalked letter by letter under the relief
variants.sound: Acoustic guitar set at low volume, a house cat somewhere, cups

subcategories.name: Urban specialty / roastery
subcategories.dna: The roaster is the altar: pale wood, raw concrete, one black counter; the smell is the decor and the barista chooses your blend.

variants.name: Roastery Bench
variants.surface: Pale ash plank, oiled, with a faint ring from a hot cup
variants.light: Tall-window daylight, neutral white, no colour cast
variants.motion: A slow curl of steam rises off the relief and dissolves
variants.sound: Grinder burr, milk steam, soft piano; room 'coffee saloon' murmur

variants.name: Black Marble Counter
variants.surface: Black marble with white veining, a brass drip tray at the edge
variants.light: One warm disc pendant over the counter; everything else falls off
variants.motion: A brass-coloured light sweep travels along the marble veins
variants.sound: Low cumbia-jazz, cups on marble, a bean hopper refilled

variants.name: Greenhouse Grid
variants.surface: Handmade yellow cement tile with black diamonds and white circles
variants.light: Five-metre window daylight filtered through palms and starfruit leaves
variants.motion: Leaf shadows drift over the dish; a leaf tip crosses the plate every few seconds
variants.sound: Greenhouse birds and water, an espresso pull every so often

subcategories.name: Art-house / gallery café
subcategories.dna: White-painted brick, pink windows, produce as a still life, the chalkboard as a hung work; the room reads like a small gallery with a kitchen.

variants.name: Pink Window
variants.surface: Stone table top against a white-painted brick ledge
variants.light: Daylight tinted pink by painted glass; soft and flattering
variants.motion: The pink tint breathes slowly brighter and dimmer, as if clouds pass
variants.sound: Quiet indie-folk, ceramic clink, a street-side bistro chair scrape

variants.name: Still Life Shelf
variants.surface: Marbled granite counter with lemons and a squash arranged at the edge
variants.light: Side-window light, one direction, painterly
variants.motion: Produce rolls into the vignette around the relief and settles
variants.sound: Gallery hush with a radio playing low behind the counter

variants.name: Exhibition Wall
variants.surface: White plaster plinth, sharp-edged, with a small printed label
variants.light: A gallery spot fades up on the dish; the room stays dim
variants.motion: Spot fades up, the label types itself, nothing else moves
variants.sound: Near silence; one soft click when the label appears

subcategories.name: Parisian classic
subcategories.dna: Red seating, mahogany and mirrors, waiters in black, a zinc counter; the decor has not changed since the war and that is the point.

variants.name: Red Banquette
variants.surface: White marble bistro top with a brass rim and a silver tray edge
variants.light: Amber globe sconces bounced in mirrors; warm, even, no shadows
variants.motion: The relief slides in on a tray at the waiter's angle and stops with a tiny bounce
variants.sound: Saucer clink, murmur, a piano standard very low; street outside

variants.name: Zinc Comptoir
variants.surface: Patinated zinc bar top with wet rings and a folded newspaper
variants.light: Morning light through the facade, slightly cool, mixed with a warm bar lamp
variants.motion: A condensation ring appears under the cup, then the plate
variants.sound: Coffee machine, newspaper fold, radio news murmur

variants.name: Saint-Germain Terrace
variants.surface: Rattan chair weave and a round marble table under a striped awning
variants.light: Soft overcast, awning glow, cigarette-haze warm
variants.motion: Awning shadow scallops drift as the wind moves the canvas
variants.sound: Boulevard traffic, a passing conversation, cutlery

subcategories.name: Listening / jazz café
subcategories.dna: A turntable and a wall of records are the kitchen's twin; whole album sides play, the room is tiny, the crowd sits outside under the stars.

variants.name: Album Side
variants.surface: Raw grey concrete with the corner of a record sleeve under the plate
variants.light: One warm bulb, late, everything else dark
variants.motion: The plate shadow turns at 33 1/3 rpm, almost imperceptibly
variants.sound: Needle drop, crackle, a spiritual-jazz side played whole

variants.name: Hi-Fi Booth
variants.surface: Walnut veneer with a strip of speaker cloth along the edge
variants.light: Amber VU-meter glow and a desk lamp
variants.motion: A VU needle bounces under the relief in time with the track
variants.sound: Turkish disco and Anatolian rock, warm and loud enough to feel

variants.name: Courtyard Night
variants.surface: Cracked Bauhaus pavement tiles with a plastic-chair shadow
variants.light: String bulbs plus the bounce of a floodlit facade across the road
variants.motion: String bulbs sway slowly; the dish is lit from two moving sides
variants.sound: Crowd under the stars, bottle clink, reggae from inside

subcategories.name: Quick-to-go / kiosk
subcategories.dna: Order at the window, no seats to fight over; the counter is the brand and the facade is the sign.

variants.name: Window Order
variants.surface: Brushed stainless counter with a ticket spike
variants.light: Bright white facade daylight, flat and clean
variants.motion: A ticket tears and the relief pops up in its place
variants.sound: Ticket printer, 'next', the knock of a portafilter

variants.name: Desert Sunset Pod
variants.surface: Gradated lava stone running red to orange to blue
variants.light: An ombre colour wash; the room itself is the light
variants.motion: The ombre cycles slowly like a sunset; the dish holds still in it
variants.sound: Bright ambient synth, a spoon on steel

variants.name: Alley Skylight
variants.surface: Whitewashed brick ledge with a steel-mesh shelf behind
variants.light: A single skylight shaft that moves with the hour
variants.motion: The skylight beam angle creeps across the plate over the session
variants.sound: Street echo, a grinder, a door chime

subcategories.name: Grand brasserie (1930s)
subcategories.dna: Light oak, cream and smoky tints, green marble banquettes, geometric chandeliers; elegance, intimacy and the spectacular in one tall room.

variants.name: Connemara
variants.surface: Connemara green marble with a sage-velvet banquette edge
variants.light: Geometric chandelier glow kept low; the marble does the shining
variants.motion: A chandelier facet glint travels across the marble once per minute
variants.sound: 1930s piano, the hush of a very tall room

variants.name: Trocadéro Cream
variants.surface: Light oak with a cream linen runner and a smoked-glass coaster
variants.light: Smoky-tinted daylight through tall columns
variants.motion: The linen settles, a silver cloche lifts and the relief is there
variants.sound: Distant string quartet, cutlery, a cork

variants.name: Black & White Floor
variants.surface: Black-and-white marble checker seen from table height
variants.light: Brass sconces, warm, with a slow push-in
variants.motion: A slow dolly along the checker perspective, then the dish lands
variants.sound: Deco-era swing at conversation level

subcategories.name: Neo-bistro / bistronomie
subcategories.dna: Rough unfinished wood, cement walls, industrial lamps from Holland, menus on office clipboards; the luxury is on the plate, not in the room.

variants.name: Clipboard
variants.surface: Rough unfinished oak plank with a clipboard clip at the corner
variants.light: Vintage industrial pendant, warm, one hard shadow
variants.motion: The clip snaps and a typed sheet slides under the relief
variants.sound: Danish-warehouse room tone, kitchen clatter, low indie

variants.name: Workshop Glass
variants.surface: Cement grey with the reflection of a steel-framed glass partition
variants.light: North daylight through workshop glazing; cool and honest
variants.motion: A steel-window reflection glides across the dish
variants.sound: Kitchen heard through glass, muffled

variants.name: Promenade Tavern
variants.surface: Dark stained oak with a sea-glass reflection at the edge
variants.light: Sunset through a west window, then candles
variants.motion: The horizon light slides down the table as the sun drops
variants.sound: An eclectic Mediterranean playlist from North Africa to the Balkans, waves faint

subcategories.name: Bouillon / people's brasserie
subcategories.dna: Red leatherette, bentwood chairs, white cloths in long rows, 300 covers, egg mayo for under two euros; the noise is the welcome.

variants.name: Rows of Red
variants.surface: White paper over a long shared table, a pencil bill scribbled at the edge
variants.light: Globe lights in a huge room, bright and even
variants.motion: The waiter's pencil writes the bill on the paper cloth beside the dish
variants.sound: 300-cover roar, trays, a laugh from three tables down

variants.name: Bentwood
variants.surface: Varnished ceramic tile with a bentwood chair back in frame
variants.light: Warm tungsten doubled in a mirror
variants.motion: A mirror doubles the dish for a beat, then the reflection dims
variants.sound: Clatter with a chanson very low under it

variants.name: Loggia
variants.surface: Pale stone balustrade ledge, looking down into the room
variants.light: Daylight from an upstairs loggia
variants.motion: Dishes arrive in a convoy, a stacked tray, the last one is yours
variants.sound: The crowd below, a bell at the pass

subcategories.name: Boutique-hotel brasserie
subcategories.dna: Clean white walls, black slatted blinds, silver trays, a handsome wooden bar; calm, a world away from the street outside.

variants.name: Slatted Blind
variants.surface: White linen over dark wood with venetian-blind stripes across it
variants.light: Blind-striped daylight, then lamp light after dark
variants.motion: The blind stripes drift one slat-width over the course of a minute
variants.sound: Hotel-bar piano, ice in a glass, a lobby door

variants.name: Silver Tray
variants.surface: A silver serving tray on walnut, slightly tarnished
variants.light: Warm lamp light, soft reflections
variants.motion: The tray's reflection swings as it is set down
variants.sound: Herb-and-bitters cocktail being stirred, low conversation

variants.name: Century House
variants.surface: Old patterned cement tile under a crisp white cloth corner
variants.light: Tall-window daylight in a hundred-year-old room
variants.motion: A slow push-in through a doorway; the room opens and the dish is centred
variants.sound: Ceiling fan, Yemenite Quarter street beyond the shutters

subcategories.name: Chef's counter
subcategories.dna: Nineteen seats in a ring around an open kitchen, a concrete counter, low-hung light, one turquoise wall; a performance you eat.

variants.name: Concrete Ring
variants.surface: Polished concrete counter, slightly cool to the touch
variants.light: A low-hung pendant pool; the rest of the room falls away
variants.motion: The pendant tightens on the relief like a spotlight, then holds
variants.sound: Near silence; a knife, a plate placed, the chef's voice

variants.name: U-Marble
variants.surface: U-shaped white marble counter with warm wood panelling behind
variants.light: Warm wall-wash, calm, no hot spots
variants.motion: A small printed course card slides in beside the relief
variants.sound: Sparse piano, a card set on marble

variants.name: Glass Kitchen
variants.surface: Hand-cut Hebron stone slab
variants.light: Gallery white with one olive-tree shadow
variants.motion: The shadow of the chef's hand passes over the dish once
variants.sound: Womb-like hush; the street exists only as a muffled hum

subcategories.name: Architectural / avant-garde
subcategories.dna: A twisted steel-and-glass exoskeleton, grey as the predominant tone, translucent acrylic tables; a meal with a beginning, a middle and an end.

variants.name: Exoskeleton
variants.surface: CNC-milled translucent acrylic lit from below
variants.light: Under-light, cool, with a faint grid
variants.motion: The acrylic glow pulses on a long breath cycle
variants.sound: A composed drone, low strings, nothing recognisable

variants.name: Rooftop Descent
variants.surface: Custom steel banquette grey with a sky reflection
variants.light: Dusk; the room darkens one notch per course
variants.motion: The camera descends one floor per course; the dish arrives at the landing
variants.sound: Wind on a rooftop, a distant city

variants.name: Noguchi Garden
variants.surface: A concrete path edge with a grass hillock behind
variants.light: Overcast Los Angeles light, soft and shadowless
variants.motion: Grass sways; the dish is the only still thing
variants.sound: Garden quiet, water somewhere

subcategories.name: Plant-forward minimal
subcategories.dna: Minimal, clean, locally sourced, with an air of understated elegance; the plate looks like a painting and the room is a cocoon.

variants.name: Cocoon
variants.surface: Natural-finish plaster plinth, matte
variants.light: Diffuse white, muffled, almost no shadow
variants.motion: The relief fades up like a painting being unveiled
variants.sound: A brush on paper, then hush

variants.name: Local Clay
variants.surface: A hand-thrown local ceramic plate on undyed linen
variants.light: Candle plus daylight mix; the glaze catches it
variants.motion: The plate turns ten degrees and the glaze flashes once
variants.sound: Low folk guitar, linen moved

variants.name: Olive Shadow
variants.surface: Hebron limestone with the shadow of an olive branch
variants.light: One leaf-shadow pattern over an otherwise flat wash
variants.motion: Olive-leaf shadows breathe with an invisible breeze
variants.sound: Cicadas faint, a fountain

subcategories.name: Street tavern
subcategories.dna: Outdoors, no reservations, under the stars, Goldstar and paper; a record library the size of the kitchen and a crowd that is the show.

variants.name: Under the Stars
variants.surface: Brown kraft paper on a bar-height table, night
variants.light: String bulbs; a floodlit facade bouncing from across the street
variants.motion: The paper crinkles as the dish lands, then flattens
variants.sound: A vinyl B-side, crowd, bottles

variants.name: Produce Pile
variants.surface: Wooden crate slats with tomatoes and an eggplant at the edge
variants.light: One bare bulb, hard and honest
variants.motion: A tomato rolls into frame and settles against the plate
variants.sound: Knife on board, Anatolian rock

variants.name: Synagogue Corner
variants.surface: Bauhaus-era terrazzo pavement with a chipped edge
variants.light: Floodlight bounce plus one bulb; a moth or two
variants.motion: A moth-flicker in the light; the dish is dead still
variants.sound: Allenby traffic hum, a DJ set from inside

subcategories.name: Living-room party
subcategories.dna: Mismatched chairs, a brick counter, big-band at deafening volume, tables that become a dance floor, burning sage at the end of the night.

variants.name: Long Table
variants.surface: White tablecloth with wine rings and a crumb line
variants.light: Warm tungsten, then 'party dim' with no strobe
variants.motion: The cloth gets bumped: the relief jumps two millimetres on a bass hit
variants.sound: Big-band swelling, clapping, table-banging

variants.name: Fire on the Floor
variants.surface: Brick counter top with a scorched steel tray
variants.light: A flambé bloom lights the dish from one side for a second
variants.motion: Flame flash, afterglow, then settle
variants.sound: Staff shout, applause, a pan hitting the pass

variants.name: Sage Hour
variants.surface: Raw wood at two in the morning, a candle stub
variants.light: Candle stubs plus the first grey of dawn
variants.motion: Sage smoke drifts across the relief and clears
variants.sound: The last song, chairs stacked, a laugh

subcategories.name: Pita counter
subcategories.dna: A deli-like open kitchen juts into the room, second-hand furniture, a comical abundance of ceiling lights, names called out, everything in a pita, on paper.

variants.name: Counter Shout
variants.surface: Stainless deli counter with a sheet of paper
variants.light: A cluster of mismatched ceiling lights, bright and silly
variants.motion: A name ticket flips and the relief slides over the counter
variants.sound: Names shouted, pans, Mediterranean pop

variants.name: Cauliflower Paper
variants.surface: Brown paper with grease blooms and a tahini streak
variants.light: A warm bulb, close
variants.motion: The paper tears open to reveal the dish
variants.sound: A tahini squeeze, a hand-clap pop

variants.name: Bleacher
variants.surface: Plywood bleacher step, scuffed
variants.light: Fluorescent plus bulbs; nothing flattering, everything fun
variants.motion: A crowd-step bounce; the dish rides it
variants.sound: Dancing, beers on tap, the pass bell

subcategories.name: Levantine light
subcategories.dna: Whitewashed brick, saffron, turmeric and brass, concrete with tile stripes, plants back-lit like latticework; Middle-Eastern without the dark heavy patterns.

variants.name: Casablanca White
variants.surface: Whitewashed plaster and concrete with a tile stripe
variants.light: Sawtooth-skylight daylight
variants.motion: A lattice-light pattern drifts over the dish as evening comes
variants.sound: Soft Maghreb-jazz, plants rustling, a bar shaker

variants.name: Brass Lattice
variants.surface: A brass tray on caramel leather
variants.light: Back-lit plants after dark, latticework shadows
variants.motion: Lattice shadows breathe on a slow cycle
variants.sound: Evening courtyard, a tray set down

variants.name: Tile Stripe
variants.surface: Orange, light-blue and white tile stripes on concrete
variants.light: Noon skylight, bright and bleached
variants.motion: Stripes scroll under the dish on load, then lock
variants.sound: Lunchtime buzz, a skylight room's echo

subcategories.name: Sea & fish house
subcategories.dna: White tablecloths that do not mean fancy, an upbeat room with music in your veins, raw fish first, a sea view if you are lucky.

variants.name: White Cloth, Loud Room
variants.surface: A white tablecloth, pressed, with a lemon half
variants.light: Warm pendants over a buzzing room
variants.motion: A cloth corner lifts in a draft and drops
variants.sound: Upbeat funk, a room laughing

variants.name: Crudo Ice
variants.surface: Crushed ice on a zinc tray, an oyster shell
variants.light: Cool white bar light with one warm candle
variants.motion: Ice shimmer; a drop of lemon lands
variants.sound: A shucking knife, white wine poured

variants.name: Sea Terrace
variants.surface: White cloth with a turquoise glass accent
variants.light: Sunset over the water, glare softened by an awning
variants.motion: The horizon light slides as the sun drops
variants.sound: Gulls, a terrace at golden hour, mainstream pop low

subcategories.name: Asia-terranean
subcategories.dna: Bamboo, iron and concrete; a banana-leaf vein cast into the walls; a black slate street-food counter and a lounge that says come join the party.

variants.name: Leaf Shadow
variants.surface: Black slate with a cast leaf-vein relief
variants.light: Leaf-silhouette lamps, warm and graphic
variants.motion: The vein pattern ripples outward from under the dish
variants.sound: A lively street, a wok, low electronic

variants.name: Iron & Bamboo
variants.surface: Bamboo slats with an iron band
variants.light: Warm and low; bamboo shadow stripes
variants.motion: Bamboo shadow stripes drift across the plate
variants.sound: A lemongrass terrace, cicadas

variants.name: Five Elements
variants.surface: Concrete with a shallow water reflection
variants.light: Fire-warm pools against metal-cool washes
variants.motion: The light cycles fire, water, metal, wood, earth on a long loop
variants.sound: Deep bass, a single water drop

subcategories.name: Japanese ritual / tea house
subcategories.dna: Stripped-back, modernised craftsmanship, tea served delicately in a bowl, thirty seats underground; serenity at the pinnacle of refinement.

variants.name: Tea Salon
variants.surface: Dark lacquered wood, flawless
variants.light: Paper-lantern soft, shadowless
variants.motion: A bowl is set down; a steam ribbon rises
variants.sound: Water poured, then silence

variants.name: Hinoki
variants.surface: Pale hinoki plank, unfinished
variants.light: Shoji-filtered daylight
variants.motion: The shoji light shifts a shade warmer
variants.sound: A single chime, a breath

variants.name: Binchotan
variants.surface: A black iron grill edge beside dark stone
variants.light: Ember orange from below
variants.motion: The ember glow pulses
variants.sound: Charcoal crackle, fat on coals

subcategories.name: Sushi counter / omakase
subcategories.dna: A wood-panelled bar with a vertical brass stripe, hand-painted fish, a coffered ceiling, a frieze of golden scales; subtle warm light.

variants.name: Golden Scales
variants.surface: Wood bar with a vertical brass-stripe edge
variants.light: Minimal lamps above the counter, warm
variants.motion: The scale frieze shimmers along the edge
variants.sound: Low house, a cocktail shaker, brass

variants.name: Hinoki Counter
variants.surface: Pale hinoki counter, wiped
variants.light: A single warm wash, nothing else
variants.motion: One piece is placed; the next appears when the first is gone
variants.sound: Rice patted, a knife

variants.name: Neon Fish
variants.surface: Coffered dark wood with a strip of old floor tile
variants.light: A neon accent on a dark room
variants.motion: The neon flickers on
variants.sound: Izakaya chatter, city-pop

subcategories.name: Trattoria vintage
subcategories.dna: Brick walls, wooden furniture, a wine rack, dried plants, objects bought in Italy and edited hard so it never becomes cliché.

variants.name: West Village Brick
variants.surface: Worn walnut with a branded coaster at the corner
variants.light: Warm and low, wine-glass shadows
variants.motion: A wine-glass shadow sways across the plate
variants.sound: Italian sixties pop, low

variants.name: Verdura
variants.surface: White marble with herb sprigs
variants.light: Window daylight, morning
variants.motion: Olive oil glistens as the light moves
variants.sound: A market morning, a knife on marble

variants.name: Dolce Vita Greenhouse
variants.surface: Floral-print banquette fabric at the edge of a marble top
variants.light: Glass-roof daylight on four floors of trattoria
variants.motion: Ivy sways under the glass
variants.sound: A four-storey room roaring, Italian pop

subcategories.name: Pizza artisan
subcategories.dna: Penny-round tiles, a white-tiled oven seen through a window, a marble bar, green leather, deco meets industrial; or worn wood, dripping candles and BYOB.

variants.name: Penny Round
variants.surface: Matte-black penny-round tile
variants.light: Oven glow plus street daylight through the window
variants.motion: The tile grid parallaxes behind the dish
variants.sound: Dough slap, an oven door

variants.name: Candle Wax
variants.surface: A worn wooden table with dripped wax
variants.light: Candles only; the tin ceiling barely visible
variants.motion: Candle flicker on the relief, nothing else
variants.sound: Old-school funk and rock and roll, low

variants.name: Brick Dome
variants.surface: Red brick beside a marble slab
variants.light: Ember light with a tin-ceiling bounce
variants.motion: An ember flare from the dome
variants.sound: A wine bottle rolling dough, a wood fire

subcategories.name: Courtyard Italian-Mediterranean
subcategories.dna: A historic building, a courtyard, an open kitchen, focaccia and fries; a subtle club vibe with a living-room listening sound system.

variants.name: Beit Courtyard
variants.surface: Old terrazzo beside a plaster wall
variants.light: Courtyard string lights and the moon
variants.motion: Focaccia steam rises and thins
variants.sound: A funk-and-reggae DJ, late

variants.name: Focaccia Board
variants.surface: Olive-wood board, oiled
variants.light: Warm, close, a candle
variants.motion: Oil pours and pools
variants.sound: Room buzz, a bottle opened

variants.name: Club Salon
variants.surface: Dark lacquer with a glass reflection
variants.light: Red-tinted club light
variants.motion: A bass pulse moves the reflection
variants.sound: An electro set in the early hours

subcategories.name: Aperitivo café-bar
subcategories.dna: White tile, tin, brick and banquettes; a century-old corner turned into a daytime Negroni hour, baby's breath in the glass.

variants.name: Negroni Hour
variants.surface: White marble with a tin-ceiling reflection
variants.light: Afternoon daylight, bright
variants.motion: Spritz bubbles rise beside the relief
variants.sound: Spoons, aperitivo chatter, Italian sixties

variants.name: Vermouth & Grapes
variants.surface: A brick ledge with a chilled-glass ring
variants.light: Amber bulb, early evening
variants.motion: A frosted glass sweats
variants.sound: Lazy jazz, ice

variants.name: Corner Chalk
variants.surface: A chalkboard of specials beside marble
variants.light: Golden hour on a street corner
variants.motion: Chalk writes today's special
variants.sound: A street corner, a bicycle bell

subcategories.name: Hidden hotel bar
subcategories.dna: A small door at the back of a lobby, wood and wicker, low light, early rock and roll loud; a seat at the bar is a coveted thing.

variants.name: Back Door
variants.surface: Dark wood with a wicker edge
variants.light: Very low amber; the door crack is the brightest thing
variants.motion: A door-crack of light widens, then the dish
variants.sound: Early rock and roll at a pulsing volume

variants.name: 1920s Quirk
variants.surface: A brass tray on green baize
variants.light: A fringed lamp, intimate
variants.motion: A bell rings and the tray spins a quarter turn
variants.sound: Ragtime piano, a shaker

variants.name: Lobby Red
variants.surface: Red faux-leather with a brass stud
variants.light: A lamp and the flicker of a small TV
variants.motion: A sign hums and flickers once
variants.sound: Lobby radio, a door

subcategories.name: Listening bar
subcategories.dna: The DJ booth is the kitchen's twin: whole album sides on a custom system, picture discs and eggplants on the same shelf.

variants.name: Dub Room
variants.surface: Speaker-cabinet plywood
variants.light: A single red bulb
variants.motion: A woofer cone pulses under the dish
variants.sound: Dub and reggae, bass you feel

variants.name: Spiritual Jazz
variants.surface: Brushed brass on walnut
variants.light: Amber, late
variants.motion: A light bloom swells with the horn
variants.sound: Hard bop and spiritual jazz

variants.name: Anatolian Picture Disc
variants.surface: A picture-disc vinyl texture
variants.light: A bulb over the booth
variants.motion: The disc spins at 45 rpm beneath the plate
variants.sound: Anatolian rock, Turkish disco

subcategories.name: Manufactory
subcategories.dna: A thermal-oil oven in the middle of the room, white plaster, concrete, gold-tinted Calacatta counters, a teal glaze; the making is the show and the smell is the signage.

variants.name: Calacatta
variants.surface: Gold-veined Calacatta marble
variants.light: Tall-window daylight
variants.motion: Flour dust drifts through the light
variants.sound: An oven hum, a tray slid in

variants.name: White Shelf
variants.surface: A simple white shelf plank with crumbs
variants.light: Overnight-bakery warm, before dawn
variants.motion: Loaf steam rises off the relief
